description.value: With a snap of the fingers, the caster commands any unattended coins from within a 30ft radius of themselves to float toward them, the coins can be directed ontop of another object, in creatures hands, and/or into bags. This cantrip does not move coins in the possession of other creatures. While moving, the coins may clink against one another or other objects, creating a lot of sounds.
